### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **playfy:** stop leaving the splash spinner up on Android 13+ ([92382d6](https://github.com/ginDoki19/GinArena-patch/commit/92382d6409f905787f63bc4b724dd9e83395ea14))
* **readme:** verify every anchor against GitHub's own renderer ([8665d37](https://github.com/ginDoki19/GinArena-patch/commit/8665d3786f3101f29b817cd45e3bbbc3bccbdc73))

### ✨ New Features

* **cricfy:** support 7.5 and drop 7.4 ([29d781b](https://github.com/ginDoki19/GinArena-patch/commit/29d781b8d4f7696772c2a1509f865b7aeee1b809))

* **daylio:** support 1.72.0 with promo, tracking and MicroG patches ([a4b8c8f](https://github.com/ginDoki19/GinArena-patch/commit/a4b8c8f80612568ab815a03faa08f1a3a98082d9))

patches.name: Google sign-in via MicroG RE
patches.description: Makes Google sign-in work on a re-signed WPS by signing in as the original app. Needs MicroG RE installed with a Google account added. WPS account login is unaffected.

options.description: Tells MicroG the app's original name and signature, which is what makes Google accept the sign-in.
Points WPS's Play services calls at MicroG instead of Google.
MicroG fails Google's signature check, so this answers the availability check with yes.
Sends push notifications through MicroG so they keep arriving.
Makes both Play services packages visible on Android 11+, so sign-in can reach MicroG. Stock WPS declares neither, so leaving this on changes nothing else.

patches.name: Unlock premium features
patches.description: Opens the paid tools - PDF, export, editing, fonts and templates - by answering the app's payment checks. Every part has its own switch, so you choose what is unlocked. Sign in first: signed out, WPS reports no membership at all.

options.description: Answers every premium check with "yes". This is the switch that actually unlocks the app - the options below it only tidy up what it produces.
Shows your account as Premium, so upgrade banners and price cards go away.
Tells the app you have a Pro membership, which opens the menu entries locked behind it.
Answers "do I own this?" with yes, so premium fonts, templates and PDF tools open.
Tells the app you are ad-free, so banner and full-screen ads are never requested.
Stops the popup that says you are already a WPS Premium user.
Removes the "Upgrade to WPS Membership" banner shown above the tool pages. It can invent usage counters, so it stays off until you want it.
Answers every AI request as not owned. Use it only if an AI tool keeps loading forever.
Tells the app ads are off before it contacts the server, so those requests never start.
Only analytics reads this. It does not affect premium, ads or sign-in.

release_notes:
## [2.12.0](https://github.com/ginDoki19/GinArena-patch/compare/v2.11.1...v2.12.0) (2026-11-17)

# GinArena Patch 2.12.0

Released 17 November 2026. This is the newest stable release. The one before it was 2.11.1.

## Summary

- CricFy TV now supports version 7.5 only. 7.4 is no longer supported.
- The bandwidth sharing popup on CricFy is gone.
- Daylio now supports version 1.72.0 only, with three new patches.
- Playfy TV no longer hangs on the splash screen on Android 13 and newer.
- No patches were removed.

Download: `patches-2.12.0.mpp`, 1,138,715 bytes
`sha256 d7ff8df97bb15ec32c8793aab55c9f352842d195512c62356c2f8779d5674a93`

Patch count went from 33 to 36.

## CricFy TV

Version 7.5 only. The patches no longer work on 7.4, so update the app first if you are still on it.

The bandwidth sharing popup is gone. On a fresh install, CricFy asked for permission to share
bandwidth every time it opened, including the first time. The setting it checks is never actually
saved, so it always asked again. Every other part of that service is already switched off, so the
box was asking about something the patched app cannot do.

The patch now closes that branch. You never see the box. Nothing is stored or faked, the app simply
never gets to ask. This was confirmed on a real device.

Everything else is unchanged: no ads, no sponsor countdowns, no startup Telegram popup, no player
app logo. The optional extras are still there and still off by default.

## Daylio

Version 1.72.0 only. 1.71.1 is no longer supported.

Three new patches:

- **Remove promos and partner ads.** Hides the BetterHelp banner and the cards promoting the
  developer's other apps.
- **Remove tracking and marketing.** Turns off analytics and crash reporting, removes advertising ID
  and install referrer access, and can also remove discount notifications. That last one is off by
  default.
- **Google Drive backup via MicroG RE.** Makes Drive backup sign in work on a re-signed Daylio. This
  needs MicroG RE installed with a Google account added. Your journal is untouched.

The premium patch is the same as before. It unlocks local premium state only and is not a purchase,
so anything that needs Daylio's servers still behaves like a free account.

## Playfy TV

One fix. On Android 13 and newer the app could stay on its splash screen forever. The patch that
skips the notification permission prompt used to jump past a step the app depends on, and nothing
else sets that step. It now goes to the place the app itself uses when permission is already
granted. No other Playfy patch changed.

## Everything else

No changes for 1DM, CricZ, CrexiFy, PlayZ, MX Player, SK Tech, APK Decompiler, WPS Office or
AdGuard. Same patches, same versions.

The only other fix was internal and affects our documentation, not the patches.

## Honest limits

- The CricFy consent fix was confirmed on a real device. The four CricFy patches were carried over
  unchanged from the dev builds and were not re-tested on a TV for this release.
- The three Daylio patches are new in this release and have not been tested on a device. Backup is
  worth checking carefully, because a re-signed app can affect Google sign in.
- The Playfy fix only concerns Android 13 and newer. Older versions were never affected.

## If something goes wrong

Tell us the app, the version you patched, which patch you ticked, and what happened instead. A
screenshot or short recording helps more than a description.

If an install is refused, uninstall the old copy first. Patched apps are signed with a different key
than the original, so Android will not install one over the other.
